identify: The photo model matched this to rice tungro disease.
Tungro is a virus disease. Green leafhoppers spread it.

thresholds.etl: Early to late tillering: 1 Tungro infected plants/m2 & 2 GLH/hill (in fungus endemic areas).

cultural: Transplant older seedlings. They are less open to virus disease.
